title: Egy igazi beszélgetés (A Real Conversation)
grammar: Spontaneous Self-Correction (vagyis inkább) & Nuanced Expressive Word Order

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can self-correct naturally during speech using vagyis inkább and pontosabban.
I can put the word I want to stress right before the verb.
I can use four words for conversation, spontaneity, reading the room and chiming in.
I can say that reading the room matters in a conversation.
